name: Sarah M.
text: They altered my wedding dress after another seamstress said the timeline was too tight. The fit was better than I expected, and they were calm and kind through the whole process.

name: Derek P.
text: I brought in jackets for our restaurant staff with a pretty small logo. The embroidery came out clean, and the colors matched our branding without me having to explain much.

name: Megan R.
text: My bridesmaid dress needed the straps shortened and the hem fixed before a Saturday wedding. They got it done on time and the dress finally felt comfortable.

name: Jared K.
text: The formalwear fitting was easy and quick. I do not usually enjoy getting measured, but they made it simple and the suit looked sharp for prom photos.

name: Lauren B.
text: I asked for a custom memory pillow made from one of my dad's shirts. The stitching was careful, and it felt like they understood why the little details mattered.

name: Anthony S.
text: They fixed a torn coat lining and replaced a zipper that had been annoying me for months. It took a few days longer than I hoped, but the repair was solid.

name: Heather L.
text: The owner has a great eye. She pinned my dress in a way that made it look tailored instead of just smaller, and that made a huge difference.

name: Brian C.
text: We used Tuxedo Shop for embroidered hats for a school fundraiser. The turnaround was reasonable, the thread work was tidy, and pickup was easy.

name: Emily W.
text: I had several pairs of pants hemmed and a blouse taken in. Everything looked natural when I picked it up, like the clothes had always fit that way.
